active_location.macro_silhouette: The Hearth is bathed in the radiant heat of the main galley stoves, casting long shadows across the smooth, polished brass and copper fixtures. The heavy scent of slow-cooked mire-lentils and roasted tubers fills the air, mingling with the metallic tang of the ferrofluid sea just beyond the thick bay windows, leaving a faint salty iron taste on the tongue. Gentle clinking of cast-iron pots and the low hum of the metabolic engine create a soothing, rhythmic backdrop to the bustling prep stations.
